name: Viviane
subtitle: Lady of the Lake
description: Empower your ally attacks with the waters of Avalon inflicting Damage on every strike.
lore: The fey enchantress also called the Lady of the Lake, Viviane appeared throughout the lives of Arthur, Merlin, and Lancelot. She is most famous for bestowing Excalibur upon Arthur, and imprisoning Merlin in stone. Since the Shattering, she has made multiple attempts to influence Arthur and Merlin away from the Morrigan’s cause, though to what purpose remains as yet unclear.

skills.description: Allies inflict 20% increased damage with their Basic Abilities. This is doubled when joining attacks.
